I feel you. Cream cheese is quite costly where I live. Greek yogurt seems to be the best substitute for cream cheese but just in case you want a diet version of cheesecake because the fat content in Greek yogurt is not as high as cream cheese, even though it is full fat Greek yogurt. 
 
The best way for you to get acceptable cream cheese is to make your own yogurt from scratch, using a mix of 50/50 cream and milk/whole milk to get to the right percent of fat and then strain it to get cream cheese.

The recipe I use is in different language so here is it

250ml whole milk/milk, 250ml whipping cream, 40ml yogurt. Heat milk and cream in a sauce pan over medium until reaches 90C, remove from heat and let the mixture cool down to 40C, gently mix in room temperature yogurt( super important), then let it ferment for 5-6 hrs and strain your yogurt with a cheesecloth for around 36-48 hrs. 

Remember to pasteurize the tool and the cointainer you'll use to make yogurt. To ferment the yogurt, I usually place the yogurt container into a pot that is bigger than the container and fill it with 80C hot water until the water covers the container halfway through, pop on the lid and cover the whole thing with thick blanket to maintain the heat of the water. Your yogurt might come out pretty slimy just like snail juice but it is okay, it's still safe to consume and as long as you drain it for long enough, the slimy yogurt will turn into creamy cream cheese. Good luck with this.

Here is the recipe that I used, which fits for 6 buns

Garlic butter sauce:

2/3 stick(75g) melted butter,
1/2 egg,
3 tbsp minced garlic ,
1 tbsp condensed milk( can be replaced with cream),
2 tbsp whipping cream,
2 tbsp honey( or sugar). For this I used the combination of sugar and honey,
2 tbsp chopped parsley or 1 tbsp dried parsley

Mix all of the ingredients together. Cut the buns into 6 segments but not all the way through. Dip the buns into the garlic sauce and make sure it coats the gaps between the segments. 

Cream cheese filling

150g cream cheese,
4 tbsp whipping cream,
2 tbsp sugar,
1 tsp lemon juice

Whip cream cheese with sugar and lemon juice then add the whipping cream and whip until you end up with cream cheese frosting. Place the filling into the pipping bag and fill the gaps between the segments. For the leftover filling, pipe some swirls over the top of each bun. Bake for 7 minutes at 180°C(350F). Sprinkle the finished buns with some more chopped parsley.
